to offer $400M of convertible senior notes due 2031 in a private offering to eligible purchasers.
The company also expects to grant the initial purchasers a 13-day option to purchase up to an additional $60M of notes.

The notes will mature on October 15, 2031, unless earlier repurchased, redeemed, or converted. The interest rate, initial conversion rate, and other terms of the notes will be determined at the time of pricing of the offering.

BKV plans to use part of the net proceeds to fund the capped call transactions and repurchase shares of common stock at the offering price, with the remaining proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes.
